description: This file defines the GatewayDiscovery class responsible for discovering network gateways via multiple network protocols and mechanisms, including mDNS, DNS-SD, and DNS queries, utilizing Kotlin coroutines for asynchronous operations.

classes.name: GatewayDiscovery
classes.description: A class responsible for discovering network gateways using mDNS, DNS-SD, and unicast DNS queries, with coroutine-based asynchronous handling.

methods.name: startLocalDiscovery
methods.description: Starts local network service discovery via NsdManager.

methods.name: stopLocalDiscovery
methods.description: Stops local network service discovery.

methods.name: startUnicastDiscovery
methods.description: Initiates unicast DNS discovery at a specified domain, running periodically.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves a network service info into GatewayEndpoint objects and updates internal state.

methods.name: publish
methods.description: Publishes current discovered gateways and updates status text.

methods.name: buildStatusText
methods.description: Builds a status string based on current discovery state.

methods.name: stableId
methods.description: Generates a stable ID for a service based on service name and domain.

methods.name: normalizeName
methods.description: Normalizes service name strings for consistent identifiers.

methods.name: txt
methods.description: Extracts a text attribute from NsdServiceInfo.

methods.name: txtInt
methods.description: Extracts an integer attribute from NsdServiceInfo.

methods.name: txtBool
methods.description: Extracts a boolean attribute from NsdServiceInfo.

methods.name: refreshUnicast
methods.description: Performs DNS queries to refresh unicast gateway information.

methods.name: decodeInstanceName
methods.description: Decodes a service instance name from FQDN to a normalized form.

methods.name: lookupUnicastMessage
methods.description: Performs a DNS query via DNSJava or direct resolver for a specific record type.

methods.name: queryViaSystemDns
methods.description: Queries DNS through the system resolver on a specified network.

methods.name: records
methods.description: Extracts section records from DNS Message.

methods.name: recordsByName
methods.description: Creates a map of DNS records indexed by name for a given DNS message and section.

methods.name: recordByName
methods.description: Finds a specific DNS record by name and type.

methods.name: resolveHostFromMessage
methods.description: Resolves hostname to IP from DNS Message's answer and additional section.

methods.name: preferredDnsNetwork
methods.description: Selects preferred network for DNS queries, preferring VPN if available.

methods.name: createDirectResolver
methods.description: Creates a custom DNS resolver over the current network's DNS servers.

methods.name: rawQuery
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous raw DNS query over a specified network.

methods.name: txtValue
methods.description: Extracts specific TXT record value by key.

methods.name: txtIntValue
methods.description: Extracts integer TXT record value.

methods.name: txtBoolValue
methods.description: Extracts boolean TXT record value.

methods.name: decodeDnsTxtString
methods.description: Decodes a DNS TXT string from ISO-8859-1 bytes to UTF-8 string.

methods.name: resolveHostUnicast
methods.description: Resolves hostname to IP address via unicast DNS queries.
